name: Badgerland Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: 33 of its 92 sites are sold by the night (the VIP pull-throughs and the hookup back-ins around the swimming pond and bathhouse); not every nightly site is in the online engine, so call for the rest. Family campground with an on-site bar, spring-fed swimming pond and catch-and-release fishing pond. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site badgerlandcampground.com read 2026-10-21 (rates, online reservations, seasonal sites, about-us policies, site map): 2026 nightly and weekly rates for water/electric 30A, 50A and VIP pull-through 50A sites, transient policies (2pm check-in, holiday-weekend minimum only), Firefly booking engine selling VIP and gravel back-in sites by the night (availability calendar showed 10+ standard RV sites per night, rate behind Firefly's captcha); operator map key shows 15 VIP pull-through + 15 50/30/20A + 3 W/E 30A + 1 rustic transient sites against 58 seasonal, i.e. about 36% nightly, no application/lease for nightly stays, no home sales; satellite (Esri, read 2026-10-21) shows gravel loops with RVs and pull-through pads -> real transient RV campground with a seasonal majority, open Apr 3 - Oct 25 2026; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Operator site map (badgerlandcampground.com/map, read 2026-10-21) puts transient 50/30/20A sites 54-57 along the east side and 52-53 on the west side of the on-site spring-fed swimming pond (~33 x 36 m, beach on its south shore); Esri satellite z19 (current, rendered) and Esri Wayback 2021-04-04 leaf-off z19 (rendered), both read 2026-10-21 at 42.97508,-89.21530: east-side pads/RVs sit ~8-12 m from the pond edge across open mowed grass, no treeline or developed strip between (a pale ring at the waterline may be a path or light fence); west-side sites partly screened by trees. No other water: the catch-and-release pond borders only seasonal sites, Lake Kegonsa is ~4.5 km away -> pond (small on-site swimming pond, precedent Countryside 1745 / Hi-Pines 3387)
fees_source: https://www.badgerlandcampground.com/rates read 2026-10-21 (rate tables posted as images dated 2026-01-22): Spring Apr 3 - May 18 2026: Water & Electric 30A $57/day, 50A $60, VIP Pull Through 50A $64; Summer & Fall May 19 - Oct 25 2026: W/E 30A $60, 50A $63, VIP $67; rustic N/A; weekly 6x daily. Rates for 2 adults + up to 4 children, 5.5% state and county tax extra, no per-night resort fee (visitor fees $5/person + $5/vehicle apply only to visitors). Firefly engine price behind its reCaptcha, not read

booking.note: 3 nights on Memorial Day, 4th of July and Labor Day weekends; the policy page's holiday dates still read 2021

flags: Nightly share ~36% (33 of 92 sites by the operator map key): mostly seasonal, but passes the 1-in-10 test comfortably.

Waterfront 'pond' rests on a ~33 m spring-fed swimming pond with a beach; east-side transient sites sit ~10 m from it on open grass. Downgrade to 'not waterfront' if AWH doesn't count a swimming hole as a pond.
Cheapest nightly site $57 spring / $60 summer (W/E 30A), VIP pull-through $64-67; in only because the price gate is lifted.
Firefly asks for RV manufacture year; the only age rule found is for SEASONAL units (15 years or newer).
Holiday-weekend 3-night minimum only; policy page's holiday dates are stale (2021).
Season Apr 3 - Oct 25 (2026); no sewer at any site (dump station + paid pump-out).
